title: Batch 1-37 strict suite certification trust store
description: Trust anchors the gate accepts for a certification signature. This file must live OUTSIDE the suite directory — a trust store inside the suite would let whoever executed the suite mint their own anchor, and scripts/test-suite/run_strict_test_gate.py rejects that layout. Exactly one non-revoked anchor may match a given signer_id.

roles.description: Must contain 'independent-certifier' for the anchor to sign a certification request.

algorithm.description: The gate accepts no other certification signature algorithm.

revoked.description: A revoked anchor cannot certify; the gate requires this to be exactly false.

public_key.description: PEM public key path, resolved beneath the trust store's own directory.

public_key_sha256.description: Must match the digest of the resolved public key file.
